gitmodules:
[submodule "SslProto/src/external/ssl-game-controller"]
	path = SslProto/src/external/ssl-game-controller
	url = https://github.com/RoboCup-SSL/ssl-game-controller
[submodule "SslProto/src/external/ssl-simulation-protocol"]
	path = SslProto/src/external/ssl-simulation-protocol
	url = https://github.com/RoboCup-SSL/ssl-simulation-protocol
[submodule "reference/specs"]
	path = reference/specs
	url = https://github.com/ibis-ssl/specs.git
SslProto_csproj:
﻿<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <Protobuf_CompileOnBuild>true</Protobuf_CompileOnBuild>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Google.Protobuf"/>
    <PackageReference Include="Grpc.Tools" PrivateAssets="All" />
  </ItemGroup>
  
  <ItemGroup>
    <Protobuf
      Include="src/external/ssl-game-controller/proto/**/*.proto"
      ProtoRoot="src/external/ssl-game-controller/proto"
      GrpcServices="None" />

    <Protobuf
      Include="src/external/ssl-simulation-protocol/proto/**/*.proto"
      Exclude="
        src/external/ssl-simulation-protocol/proto/ssl_gc_common.proto;
        src/external/ssl-simulation-protocol/proto/ssl_vision_geometry.proto;
        src/external/ssl-simulation-protocol/proto/ssl_vision_detection.proto
      "
      ProtoRoot="src/external/ssl-simulation-protocol/proto"
      AdditionalImportDirs="
        src/external/ssl-game-controller/proto/state;
        src/external/ssl-game-controller/proto/vision
      "
      GrpcServices="None" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
